the_signal.headline: Knowledge graphs vs. vector RAG: pick your grounding strategy now
the_signal.body: n8n's fresh breakdown on LLM knowledge graphs versus vector RAG cuts through the noise—your choice here directly impacts retrieval accuracy and latency in revenue workflows. For GTM engineers building AI-powered customer engines, this is the architectural decision that separates reliable systems from flaky ones. Pick wrong and you're debugging hallucinations in production; pick right and your AI agents stay grounded under load.

thread_of_day.title: iPaaS vs. API Management: execution control is the real differentiator
thread_of_day.takeaway: Teams chasing self-hosting, code-level extensibility, and full execution control are abandoning traditional iPaaS/API management for platform automation tools.

quote.text: An LLM knowledge graph and vector RAG ground models differently. See when to use each, how to build a knowledge graph from text, and how to run both smoothly.
quote.source: n8n Blog: When to Use an LLM Knowledge Graph or a Vector RAG

whats_moving.context: Knowledge graphs and vector RAG are converging as production patterns; GTM teams need to understand trade-offs between structured recall and semantic retrieval.
n8n Agents signal that workflow automation is shifting from human-choreographed sequences to AI-driven decision-making at scale.
n8n's comparison of iPaaS, API management, and workflow platforms shows engineering teams are consolidating tools around execution control, not connectivity alone.

act_on_this: Map your current AI workflow dependencies (LLM calls, external APIs, internal data sources) and decide: are you building knowledge graphs for structured queries or vector RAG for semantic search? Run a 48-hour spike on whichever fits your customer data shape.
